traits.label: Hymenium
traits.text: Gills white to creamy-white, crowded, with numerous shorter lamellulae; developing pinkish to reddish stains when bruised or with age
traits.raw: ℹ️ Hymenium: Gills white to creamy-white, crowded, with numerous shorter lamellulae; developing pinkish to reddish stains when bruised or with age

traits.label: Cap
traits.text: Hemispherical to convex when young, later broadly convex to flat; highly variable, pale pinkish-brown, grey-brown, reddish-brown to dark brown; usually covered with irregular greyish-white, pinkish-grey to brownish universal-veil warts; margin generally non-striate
traits.raw: ℹ️ Cap: Hemispherical to convex when young, later broadly convex to flat; highly variable, pale pinkish-brown, grey-brown, reddish-brown to dark brown; usually covered with irregular greyish-white, pinkish-grey to brownish universal-veil warts; margin generally non-striate

traits.label: Hymenium Attachment
traits.text: Adnate to nearly free
traits.raw: ℹ️ Hymenium Attachment: Adnate to nearly free

traits.label: Stipe
traits.text: White to pale pinkish, cylindrical, often slightly enlarged or bulbous at base; progressively staining pink to wine-red when damaged; volva poorly developed and usually disappearing with age; membranous, pendulous ring distinctly striate on upper surface
traits.raw: ℹ️ Stipe: White to pale pinkish, cylindrical, often slightly enlarged or bulbous at base; progressively staining pink to wine-red when damaged; volva poorly developed and usually disappearing with age; membranous, pendulous ring distinctly striate on upper surface

traits.label: Spore print
traits.text: Spore print white
traits.raw: ⚪ Spore print white

traits.label: Ecology
traits.text: Mycorrhizal with hardwoods and conifers; alone, scattered or gregariously; deciduous, coniferous and mixed forests; especially frequent on acidic, nutrient-poor soils; summer to autumn
traits.raw: 🌲🌳 Mycorrhizal with hardwoods and conifers; alone, scattered or gregariously; deciduous, coniferous and mixed forests; especially frequent on acidic, nutrient-poor soils; summer to autumn

traits.label: Edibility
traits.text: Edible only after thorough cooking; poisonous raw, easily confused
traits.raw: 🍲⚠️ Edible only after thorough cooking; poisonous raw, easily confused

traits.label: Uses & compounds
traits.text: Rubescenslysin, a thermolabile haemolytic/cytolytic protein toxin
traits.raw: ⚕️ Rubescenslysin, a thermolabile haemolytic/cytolytic protein toxin

traits.label: Fruit body
traits.text: Fruit body medium to large; stipe ~7–15 cm long and ~1–2(–3) cm thick
traits.raw: 📏 Fruit body medium to large; stipe ~7–15 cm long and ~1–2(–3) cm thick

traits.label: Dimensions
traits.text: Cap ∅ ~5–20 cm
traits.raw: 📐 Cap ∅ ~5–20 cm

traits.label: Flesh
traits.text: White, slowly turning pale pink, wine-red to reddish when cut, bruised or damaged, especially in the stipe base and around insect tunnels
traits.raw: 🔪 White, slowly turning pale pink, wine-red to reddish when cut, bruised or damaged, especially in the stipe base and around insect tunnels

traits.label: Chemical reactions
traits.text: No macroscopic reagents reaction
traits.raw: 🧪 No macroscopic reagents reaction

traits.label: Odour
traits.text: Mild, indistinct, mushroomy; sometimes unpleasant in old specimens
traits.raw: 👃 Mild, indistinct, mushroomy; sometimes unpleasant in old specimens

traits.label: Taste
traits.text: Mild, indistinct
traits.raw: 👅 Mild, indistinct

traits.text: Spores broadly ellipsoid to ovoid, smooth, hyaline, amyloid, ~8–10 × 5–7 µm; basidia predominantly 4-spored; clamp connections absent at basidial bases; lamellar trama bilateral
traits.raw: 🔬 Spores broadly ellipsoid to ovoid, smooth, hyaline, amyloid, ~8–10 × 5–7 µm; basidia predominantly 4-spored; clamp connections absent at basidial bases; lamellar trama bilateral
